04 / About Peppers

A few things
to know.

Information about the team, visits, and supporting our work.

Email Peppers ↗
How does recruitment work? +

We recruit at school only. Recruitment information is shared in school.

Can I visit or see a robot? +

Open shop days and community activities are opportunities to meet us. Check the event listings for visit information and confirmed arrangements before making plans.

Browse upcoming events ↗
How can I support Peppers? +

Funding, components, fabrication, workshop space, and equipment can all help students keep building.

Write to contact@peppers-robotics.ro to discuss how you would like to support the team.

Contact the team ↗
What about mentoring? +

Sharing practical experience can help students work through design, electronics, programming, and communication challenges.

Tell us about your experience and how you would like to help at contact@peppers-robotics.ro.

Contact the team ↗
Where is Peppers based? +

We’re FTC Team 19044 from Iași, Romania, based at Liceul Teoretic de Informatică “Grigore Moisil”.

PEPPERS19044

More than robots.
We’re building tomorrow.

Peppers Robotics is a student-and-alumni STEM community and FIRST Tech Challenge team from Iași, Romania, based at Liceul Teoretic de Informatică “Grigore Moisil”.

Mechanical design, electronics, software, and outreach come together in our workshop. Beyond competition, we share robotics through education, mentoring, and community activities.
